# Data card: Urdu corpus

<!-- Generated by clean/data_card.py from data/stats/*.json, collect/sources.json and data/final/manifest.json. Do not edit by hand: the gaps section comes from docs/data_card_gaps.md. -->

**Summary.** 1,299.86 MB of cleaned Urdu text (961,176 documents, 153,465,131 words) from 5 sources in 6 genres, split by document into train, val and test (98/1/1, seed 1337, stratified by source) with <|endoftext|> after each document. The largest parts are FineWeb-2 (urd_Arab) (45.0%) and Urdu Wikipedia (39.8%), and 76.01 MB is our own crawl of VOA Urdu and Hum Sub.

MB = 10^6 bytes, MiB = 2^20 bytes. Words are `str.split()` tokens; unique words are distinct runs of `[\p{L}\p{M}\u200c]`.

## Cleaning steps

| Step | What it does | MB removed | % of step input | Docs removed |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1. Extract plain text | Text out of dumps, CSV, parquet and HTML; Wikipedia: articles only, no redirects, disambiguation or bodies under 200 characters | 2,017.06 | 17.3% | 2,426,588 |
| 2. Normalize | normalize.py, rules below | 13.98 | 0.1% | 0 |
| 3. Line language filter | Drop lines with no letters, mostly not Arabic script, Sindhi, or Arabic/Persian; drop Sindhi documents (217 from our VOA crawl) and documents under 10 words (3 for UFAL) | 59.88 | 0.6% | 100,531 |
| 4. Boilerplate lines | Drop lines found in 5 or more documents of a source (3 for our crawl) | 312.77 | 3.3% | 6,685 |
| 5. Exact document dedup | Drop exact duplicate documents, within and across sources | 39.48 | 0.4% | 49,420 |
| 6. Budget subsample | Keep documents by blake2b(doc_id) to fit the budget: Urdu News 1M 0.0%, UFAL 9.1%, FineWeb-2 9.9% kept, the rest whole | 7,907.29 | 86.0% | 7,258,772 |
| **Total** | From extracted text to the corpus | 10,350.45 | 88.9% | 9,841,996 |

Step 1 counts the UTF-8 text read from each container, so Wikipedia's removed bytes are mostly markup and non-article pages. Per-source numbers: [docs/cleaning_detail.md](docs/cleaning_detail.md).

## Normalization

| Rule (normalize.py, in order of application) | Changed | Per million chars |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Presentation forms → letters (ﷲ → اللہ; ﷺ ﷻ kept) | 2,755 | 508 |
| Arabic yeh ي ى → Urdu yeh ی | 3,399 | 626 |
| Arabic kaf ك → ک (Sindhi ڪ kept) | 319 | 59 |
| Arabic heh ه ە → ہ; ة → ۃ; ۀ → ۂ | 1,439 | 265 |
| Letter + combining madda/hamza → one code point (NFC) | 2,228 | 411 |
| Arabic-Indic and Urdu digits → ASCII | 3,058 | 564 |
| Tatweel removed | 30 | 6 |
| ZWJ, bidi marks, BOM, soft hyphen, controls removed; ZWNJ kept only inside words | 49 | 9 |
| Whitespace: no-break spaces and tabs → space, runs collapsed, lines trimmed, no blank lines | 1,698 | 313 |
| No space before ۔ ، ؟ ؛ | 10,970 | 2,022 |

Changed: occurrences that `normalize()` altered in the Step 4 audit samples (about 2 MB per source, 5,425,930 characters). On the whole corpus, normalization shrank the text from 9,620.76 to 9,606.78 MB (0.1%).

## Known gaps and biases

- <!-- REVIEW --> **Genre balance.** Web is the largest genre at 45.3% of the text (web 45.3%, encyclopedia 39.9%, news 5.3%, mixed 5.0%, journalism/essays 3.9%, opinion/blogs 0.6%). Wikipedia is kept whole (39.8%), so encyclopedic register is over-represented next to everyday Urdu. FineWeb-2 is capped at 45% and subsampled (rate 0.0986), and UFAL is subsampled (rate 0.0910). Urdu News 1M lost its sentence punctuation and some letters at source (اسلام آباد stored as اسلام باد), so it contributes only 0.0%.
- <!-- REVIEW --> **Time periods.** The FineWeb-2 text comes from one of its two files, so it covers Common Crawl snapshots CC-MAIN-2021-10 to 2024-18 only; the 2013–2021 crawls are in the file we did not download. UFAL was released in 2014, and its sentences are shuffled, so they carry no document context. VOA Urdu articles date from 2010-01-01 to 2025-03-15, Hum Sub posts from 2016-01-12 to 2025-07-11, and the Wikipedia dump is from 2026-10-01. CC-100 (2018 crawls) was not used.
- <!-- REVIEW --> **Script.** Only Urdu in Arabic script is kept. Roman Urdu is excluded by design: lines mostly in other scripts are dropped unless they hold Urdu function words. Expect the tokenizer to handle Roman Urdu poorly.
- <!-- REVIEW --> **Religious and poetic text.** The line filter removed 87,447 lines (25.11 MB) as Arabic or Persian, mostly Quran and hadith quotations and Persian verse, and 226 whole Sindhi documents (3.05 MB of Sindhi lines, including the Sindhi pages in our VOA crawl). Religious and classical poetic writing is therefore under-represented. Short unvowelled Arabic quotations inside Urdu sentences remain.
- <!-- REVIEW --> **Bot-generated stubs.** Many Wikipedia articles are template stubs made by bots (asteroids, railway stations, census places, footballers): 9 of 20 sampled articles in Step 3. Boilerplate removal took their shared headings (the asteroid heading was in 26,587 articles), but the template sentences stay, so these patterns are over-represented. No near-duplicate detection was run.
- <!-- REVIEW --> **ه (U+0647).** Normalization maps every Arabic heh to gol heh ہ (237 per million characters in the Step 4 audit samples). Where a writer typed ه inside a word for do-chashmi heh (بهی for بھی), the result is a misspelling (بہی), not the intended letter.
- <!-- REVIEW --> **Regional variety.** Most sources are Pakistani: VOA Urdu's Pakistan coverage, Hum Sub, Makhzan, and the outlets of Urdu News 1M. Of FineWeb's documents in the corpus, 31.0% have a .pk domain and 0.6% an .in domain (45.0% .com), so Indian Urdu is under-represented; the domain is only a rough proxy. Punjabi and Saraiki written in Shahmukhi share the script and can pass the language filter: 19 documents contain ݨ (U+0768), a letter of those languages and not of Urdu. Other leakage is not measured.

## Rebuild

From the downloads in `data/raw/` (Steps 1-2 in README.md):

```bash
python clean/extract_all.py --wiki-jobs 7          # Step 3: extract
python clean/audit_chars.py && python clean/audit_chars.py --normalized   # Step 4: audit samples
python clean/normalize_filter.py --jobs 7          # Step 5: normalize + line language filter
python clean/dedup.py                              # Step 5b: boilerplate lines + exact dedup
python clean/budget.py --fill fineweb2_urd ufal_umc urdu_news_1m   # Step 6: budget
python clean/split.py && python clean/corpus_stats.py
python -m pytest -q -s tests/test_split.py && python clean/data_card.py
```
